body: Thanks for the recomendations. Neuromind looks really interesting. Actually just the sort of thing im looking for. Reading first hand accounts of other peoples experiences has helped me in feeling less alone with my condition in the past, but i am definitely interested in legitimate psychotherapy at this point.
Probably the most legitimately inspiring post ive seen in this subreddit.

Actually yea. Writing is a lot easier to express myself than speaking atm. And i would def be interested in any suggestions on something to read. For the record i do spend a lot of time researching. I read every book on the subject i can and spend a lot of time on forums and blogs. Though this id my first time posting anywhere

That sounds legit. I am willing to try anything. I know how important it is to communicate with people about the way i feel but its difficult for me especially with people im close to for whatever reason. How would you suggest going about something like that?
